messages:
melissa: Heads up — quick payroll issue after Luna's repoint to hybrid last month. She got charged two local 'occupational' taxes on 3/15 pay. Can payroll check?

oliver (payroll): On it. Do you have paystub screenshot or payrun id?

melissa: Yes — payrun #PR-2026-03-15. paystub lines below:
```
Earnings    Regular   32 hrs  $1,600
Gross pay              $1,600
Federal                $240
State-CA               $80
Local - San Mateo (occ) $16
Local - Redwood City (occ) $16
Net pay                $1,248
```
She lives in San Mateo now but our ADP record had her worksite set to Redwood City. Looks like both local occ taxes were applied.

payroll-bot: Auto-detected mismatch: employee address (employee record) = San Mateo; pay location = Redwood City. Flag: duplicate local occupational tax applied. Suggested action: off-cycle refund + HRIS update.

oliver (payroll): Got it. @lauren can you confirm whether Luna submitted address change in HRIS? If not, we need to update before correction.

lauren: She updated home address on 2026-03-01 but People Ops created a 'worksite' tag for hybrid that was accidentally left set to RC office. I can remove the worksite tag and align payroll mapping tonight.

jamal: Thx. Also FYI Luna is 0.6 FTE (part-time) but current payrun shows a full-time hours calc for this period — possible timecard vs earnings calc mismatch. Could be why gross looks wrong too.

melissa: HR confirmed timecard was 32 hrs; earnings should be $1,600, but previous cycle paid 80 hrs erroneously. We need corrected gross + reverse the duplicate local tax. Can payroll calculate corrected gross and apply refund?

oliver (payroll): Plan: 1) Pause next scheduled pay for Luna until we confirm mapping. 2) Create off-cycle retro pay (PR-OC-1849999999) to correct hours/gross. 3) Reverse duplicate local occ tax and issue refund of extra $16 (the duplicate RC occ). 4) Add audit note + update employee tax mapping. ETA: end of day Friday. Any objections?

lauren: :thumbsup: no objections. I'll remove the RC worksite flag now and push HRIS sync.

melissa: Please CC Luna on the off-cycle schedule so she isn't surprised. Luna's preferred email is luna@example.com.

payroll-bot: Off-cycle request PR-OC-1849999999 created. Assigned to oliver. Status: queued.

oliver (payroll): Running the adjustment today. I'll post the breakdown here when complete.

oliver (payroll): Update: processed refund and retro today. Corrections applied as follows:
```
Corrected gross (32 hrs)        $1,600
Withholdings corrected:        Federal $240, State $80, Local (San Mateo) $16
Refund issued (duplicate RC occ) $16 -> paid out as off-cycle net + memo
Payroll records: PR-OC-1849999999, audit note added
Employee notification: email sent to luna@example.com
```
All done. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
